sources.title: Open Knowledge Format version 0.2
usage: `references/layout.md` → the bundle and its reserved names
`references/frontmatter.md` → concept IDs, actors, `verified`, timestamps, unknown keys, sources and footnotes, status
`references/generated-files.md` → indexes without frontmatter, grouped entries, the date-grouped log

claims.statement: A change is a bundle; `index.md` and `log.md` are reserved and hold no concept → layout
The concept ID is the path without `.md` → frontmatter, Essentials
The `human:` prefix is reserved for content a person wrote or confirmed → frontmatter, Essentials
Timestamps carry an explicit UTC offset; unknown keys survive every edit; a superseded document is deprecated, never deleted → frontmatter, Gotchas
Indexes group entries under headings; the log is grouped by date, newest first → generated files

sources.title: Xonovex change-workflow conventions
sources.provenance: Repository-original contract of the change directory shared by the workflow steps: names and suffixes, write rules, the entry step, the project settings, the family level, the shared schemas and templates, and the validator

claims.statement: The entry step, the slug-suffix names, append-only versus edited-in-place files, the skills map with its defaults, the family level, the shared schemas and the three validation layers are conventions of this workflow.
